tone: a weaver's wage book read beside an 1812 broadside: plain, counted, angry underneath
identity.paletteIntent: soot black and raw wool cream, with the natural dyes of the period: madder red for loss and violence, weld yellow for what money could buy, indigo for London and the law
identity.typographyIntent: a fat face display type like the broadsides of the 1810s, a Caslon text face for narrative, a ledger mono for dates, wages and records
textureLanguage: woven cloth grain on cream pieces
loom warp threads on dark pieces
aged letter paper for the primary source
identity.shapeLanguage: numbered pieces of cloth with double rule selvedges, stitched picture plates, bolts of cloth that grow, flour sacks that empty
motionGrammar: weaving: a thread runs along the strip as the reader moves through the story
replacement: the power loom bolt outruns the hand loom bolt three and a half to one
accumulation and loss: flour sacks fill and empty between 1797 and 1834
geography: markers light up across the north as the uprising spreads
interactionSignature: walk the uprising on a map
count a week's pay in flour
identity.densityRhythm: Ten pieces alternating wool and soot, short reading blocks, one instrument in most pieces, and a quiet glossary and note repair before the questions.
identity.archivalBehavior: Period engravings, prints and portraits are captioned and credited. Testimony to Parliament is attributed. The boy's three and a half pieces is labeled as a claim that spread, and contested numbers are named in the limits.
identity.endingLanguage: The people who did well understood the work well enough to direct the machines and fix them.

assetToInterfaceTranslation.paletteSource: The soot and cream of the 1835 Allom engraving, the madder and weld in the 1812 Leader of the Luddites print, and the cream of the watercolor loom
assetToInterfaceTranslation.edgeTreatment: Double rule selvedge headers, dashed stitch lines inside picture plates, aged paper for the letter
assetToInterfaceTranslation.controlLanguage: Square ledger buttons in mono type, a madder fill when chosen, a woven bolt for progress
assetToInterfaceTranslation.spacingLanguage: Each section is a numbered piece with a ledger tag naming place and date
assetToInterfaceTranslation.transitionLanguage: Natural scrolling, with state changes driven by the race, the year switch and the map slider
